text:
Jordan: quickcheck alert — post-deploy smoke failing for embed-service eu-west-2 at 20% canary. synthetic probes hitting /v1/embeds returning intermittent 502 and one 500 when payloads include base64 attachments.

Priya: do we have a repro?

Jordan: yes ran a targeted run (n=30) — 4x 502 against host eu2-node-21. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://eu-west-2.embed.internal/v1/embeds -d '{"input":"<long string>"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"upstream decode error","backend":"embed-proxy"}
```

deploy-bot: Pausing rollout for embed-service at stage=canary (20%). No further promotions. To rollback: `deploy rollback embed-service --to-version=v3.9.4 --reason="smoke 502s host-isolation"`.

Kevin: pin the failing host out of rotation if possible, but rollback seems safest for customer routes.

Sara: agree. also annotate the rollback in the release notes and add a short change-window hold.

Jordan: initiating rollback now with force flag, ETA ~2m to drain. monitoring quickchecks.

smokebot: post-rollback run (n=40) -> 0 failures, p95/p99 within baseline.

Priya: created INF-2381 with logs and reproducer, assigned to runtime-team for grpc proxy chunk parsing investigation. Added note to release_notes: "Reverted embed-service v3.10.0 due to intermittent 502s from embed-proxy on canary; rolled back to v3.9.4."

Kevin: add host-isolation guard to quickcheck harness (if single-host cluster of failures then auto-pin).

Jordan: opened follow-up task and will coordinate a staged re-roll when fix lands. Closing thread — thanks all :thumbsup:
